name: set_selected_object_initial_position

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_SetSelectedObjectInitialPosition consumes three coordinates, converts them to floats, and queues object operation type 0x20 for the selected object

notes: Operation type 0x20 maps to the embedded INIT_POS name. ScriptCommand_SetSelectedObjectInitialPosition stores the X, Y, and Z coordinates in the operation vector with W set to 1.0. The JP corpus contains 462 calls.
